'''''Crazy Women''''' ({{langx|es|Las locas}}) is a 1977 Argentine [[drama film]] written by José P. Dominiani and directed by [[Enrique Carreras]]. It was entered into the [[10th Moscow International Film Festival]] where [[Mercedes Carreras]] won the award for Best Actress.<ref name="Moscow1977">{{cite web|url=http://www.moscowfilmfestival.ru/miff34/eng/archives/?year=1977 |title=10th Moscow International Film Festival (1977) |accessdate=January 13, 2013 |work=MIFF |archivedate=January 16, 2013 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130116194935/http://www.moscowfilmfestival.ru/miff34/eng/archives/?year=1977 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
